name: verify-gate
description: When a turn changes code, runs the project's own lint and tests; failures go straight back to Claude (up to a retry limit), so done means green.

checkCommand.title: Check command
checkCommand.description: Shell command to run instead of the detected checks (e.g. `make check`). Empty: detect ruff/pytest or package.json scripts.

runTests.title: Run tests too
runTests.description: Off runs lint and typecheck only.

maxRetries.title: Automatic retries
maxRetries.description: How many times a failure is sent back to Claude before handing over to you (0-5).
